按 Pod 的读取吞吐
按 Pod 的写入吞吐

targets.expr: rate(unifabric_out_of_sequence{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", topowner_kind=~"$kind", topowner_kind!="", topowner_namespace=~"$namespace", topowner_namespace!="", topowner_name=~"$name", topowner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval])

rate(unifabric_packet_seq_err{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", topowner_kind=~"$kind", topowner_kind!="", topowner_namespace=~"$namespace", topowner_namespace!="", topowner_name=~"$name", topowner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: RDMA 发送明细（CPU 侧发起）
累计发送字节
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，该 Workload 内部发送的 payload 字节总量。

targets.expr: sum(increase(rdma_flow_bytes_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 累计 WR
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，该 Workload 内部提交的 work request 总数。

targets.expr: sum(increase(rdma_flow_wrs_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 累计发送次数
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，该 Workload 内部捕获的发送提交总数。

targets.expr: sum(increase(rdma_flow_sends_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 活跃 QP
panels.description: 当前归属于该 Workload 内部流的活跃 QP 数。

targets.expr: sum(rdma_flow_qps{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"})

panels.title: 按源 Pod 累计发送字节
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，Workload 内各源 Pod 的累计发送字节。

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_bytes_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range])))

panels.title: 按对端 Pod 累计发送字节
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，Workload 内各对端 Pod 的累计接收字节。

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_bytes_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Workload 对外流量明细
panels.description: 所选 Workload 发往各目的 Pod 和网卡对的累计字节、WR、发送次数与活跃 QP。

targets.expr: sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name, src_device, dst_device) (increase(rdma_flow_bytes_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range]))

sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name, src_device, dst_device) (increase(rdma_flow_wrs_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range]))

sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name, src_device, dst_device) (increase(rdma_flow_sends_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"}[$__range]))

sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name, src_device, dst_device) (rdma_flow_qps{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_top_owner_namespace="$namespace", src_pod_top_owner_kind="$kind", src_pod_top_owner_name="$name"})

panels.title: 网卡累计发送
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，该 Workload 各 RDMA 网卡计数器的累计发送字节，用于和 eBPF payload 累计字节对比。

targets.expr: sum by (device, ifname) (increase(unifabric_port_xmit_data{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", topowner_kind=~"$kind", topowner_namespace=~"$namespace", topowner_name=~"$name"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 网卡累计读取
panels.description: 所选时间范围内，该 Workload 各 RDMA 网卡计数器的累计接收字节，用于和 eBPF 发送侧数据对照。

targets.expr: sum by (device, ifname) (increase(unifabric_port_rcv_data{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", topowner_kind=~"$kind", topowner_namespace=~"$namespace", topowner_name=~"$name"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 最常见的消息大小 Top 20
panels.description: 该 Workload 内 Pod 发送的 bytes 精确值，按发送次数排序。大模型通信的消息大小高度重复，这里直接看出该 Workload 用了哪几种大小与各自占比。数据来自 Elasticsearch 的流事件。

list.definition: query_result(count by (cluster_name) (global_cluster_info) or label_replace(vector(1) unless on() global_cluster_info, "cluster_name", "本地集群", "", ""))
list.label: 集群
list.name: cluster_name

query.query: query_result(count by (cluster_name) (global_cluster_info) or label_replace(vector(1) unless on() global_cluster_info, "cluster_name", "本地集群", "", ""))

list.definition: query_result(count by (cluster) (global_cluster_info{cluster_name="$cluster_name"}) or label_replace(vector(1) unless on() global_cluster_info, "cluster", "^$", "", ""))
list.name: cluster

query.query: query_result(count by (cluster) (global_cluster_info{cluster_name="$cluster_name"}) or label_replace(vector(1) unless on() global_cluster_info, "cluster", "^$", "", ""))
